miners.name: MiaSanData
miners.description: Predicts FC Bayern Munich match outcomes as calibrated win/draw/loss probabilities using an Elo-based model. Autonomous agents can query this Miner for a trustworthy signal instead of raw unverified odds.

miners.name: Telegraph Knowledge Chatbot
miners.description: Telegraph protocol knowledge assistant. Answers questions about the Telegraph Network — its vision, tokenomics (Machina), architecture, smart contracts, miners, validators, payments (x402/ERC-8183), P2P networking, epoch settlement, roadmap, and how to build on Telegraph. Also handles general chat and web search. Use this miner when the user asks "What is Telegraph?", "Telegraph roadmap", "How does Telegraph work?", or any Telegraph protocol question.

miners.name: Amazon Nova 2 Lite
miners.description: Amazon Nova 2 Lite — web-grounded answers with live search citations, 1M context. Best for current events. Served by the Telegraph node's managed inference backend (AWS Bedrock), exposed as a single-model integration.

miners.name: LiteLLM Bedrock Proxy
miners.description: LiteLLM proxy providing OpenAI-compatible access to AWS Bedrock models (Nova Pro, Nova 2 Lite, Nova Premier, DeepSeek, Voxtral, Qwen, Kimi). Nova 2 Lite and Nova Premier support live web search via Amazon Nova grounding.

miners.name: Google Gemini
miners.description: Google Gemini via the AI Studio OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The free tier requires no credit card and has no expiry (~1,500 req/day, 1M TPM on Flash models). Serves gemini-flash-latest and gemini-flash-lite-latest for chat and multimodal inference. NOTE: confirm exact free model IDs against /models with your key — Google rotates Flash versions (2.5 / 3.5 / 3.6).

miners.name: Qwen (Bedrock)
miners.description: Alibaba Qwen — general chat, no web search. 262K context. Served by the Telegraph node's managed inference backend (AWS Bedrock), exposed as a single-model integration.

miners.name: Voxtral (Bedrock)
miners.description: Voxtral — fast and lightweight, no web search. 128K context. Served by the Telegraph node's managed inference backend (AWS Bedrock), exposed as a single-model integration.

miners.name: Kimi (Bedrock)
miners.description: Moonshot Kimi — long-context chat, no web search. 262K context. Served by the Telegraph node's managed inference backend (AWS Bedrock), exposed as a single-model integration.

miners.name: OpenRouter
miners.description: OpenRouter gateway restricted to :free models — no credit card required. One key fronts many free open models: OpenAI gpt-oss, Google Gemma 4, and NVIDIA Nemotron. NOTE: the free list rotates — confirm current :free model IDs against https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models.

miners.name: DeepSeek (Bedrock)
miners.description: DeepSeek — strong reasoning, no web search. 163K context. Served by the Telegraph node's managed inference backend (AWS Bedrock), exposed as a single-model integration.
